messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall - elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/console/routes (console API). Started ~1855009600 UTC, surge at 09:03. Symptoms: console returns 500 for customers, dataplane model endpoints appear healthy (no token errors). Escalate to eng-sre and api teams.

Maria G: acked - I'm the primary oncall. joining bridge. initial triage: are we sure this is control-plane-only? any client-side retries/hits to dedicated?

Sanjay R: I see errors in the console-service logs: repeated 502 from controlplane-cache lookup, stack shows timeout against config-store. Dataplane traces show normal token throughput.

Priya S: +1 dataplane metrics look normal. Key thing: customers report console UI failures but generation requests still succeed. likely propagation/config issue.

Maria G: starting timeline build here, please paste log snippets and short notes in-thread. I'll compile.

Kevin T: Sharing snippets from control-plane pod 2 logs (truncated):
```
[09:02:58] ERROR controlplane.helpers - failed to fetch route config for org=acme-corp: timeout after 3s
[09:03:01] WARN controlplane.cache - cache-miss fallback to db for route=ui-route; db read 503
[09:03:04] ERROR controlplane.api - respond 500 internal when resolving routes: KeyError('silo-flag')
```

Alex M: From console-ingester we see 500 responses returned upstream to browser with body 'internal server error'. No obvious spikes in CPU/mem.

Maria G: Hypothesis tracker:
- Hypothesis 1: config propagation delay/partial rollout (feature flag /silo-routing-v2) to control plane nodes leading to KeyError -> 500.
- Hypothesis 2: a recent deploy changed config schema and console service cannot parse new shape (parsing KeyError).
- Hypothesis 3: cache layer (redis/memcache) eviction spike causing fallthroughs to a failing DB.

Sanjay R: Quick checks I ran:
- curl against controlplane /health returned ok on some instances, failing on others.
- controlplane-debug shows inconsistent env var SiloFlag=undefined on 2 of 6 pods.

Maria G: Good. Can someone confirm recent deploys? Eng-SRE Bot, do we have deploys for controlplane in the last 15m?

Eng-SRE Bot: Deploy event: controlplane v3.18.4 -> started 1855009205, completed 1855009802 on subset region-us-west-2 (canary then rolling). 2 pods still on older revision at 1855009700.

Priya S: That aligns - rolling deploy overlap + feature flag rollout might cause mixed states. If older pods expect a flag present and new pods removed it (or vice versa) that could cause KeyError paths.

Kevin T: I can force a rebuild of the config-store cache on affected controlplane nodes. But need approval for a mitigation step: roll back the deploy vs toggle flag. Thoughts?

Maria G: Customer impact assessment: initial alert shows ~0.8% of total console requests failing in last 5m, concentrated in US-WEST customers. Two paying accounts reported UI failures but model API OK. Risk of expand if rollouts continue.

Alex M: Fast mitigation suggestion: pin controlplane to same revision (stop rolling) and force config-store warmup, or toggle the feature flag to previous state. Rolling back might be heavier.

Sanjay R: I can toggle feature flag in featuregate service to safe mode for affected orgs only. Prefer narrow blast radius. Will test on staging then apply to affected region.

Maria G: Go ahead with staged toggle. Keep one person on rollback prep in case toggle doesn't work. Kevin, prepare cache-warmup script.

Kevin T: cache-warmup script ready. Running on affected nodes now:
```
#!/bin/bash
for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=controlplane -o name); do
  kubectl exec $pod -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -sS http://localhost:8080/internal/warm-config || true' &
done
wait
```

Sanjay R: Feature toggle applied to us-west-2 canary orgs at 1855009999. Monitoring.

Maria G: Observability notes: please paste dashboards or short metrics: 5xx pct, latency p50/p95, config-store error counts.

Kevin T: 5xx pct went from 0.8% -> 0.3% after warmup + toggle. config-store errors dropped by ~70% in affected pods. p95 latency unchanged.

Priya S: Customer reports: one org confirmed UI recovered at 09:10 UTC. No new support tickets after mitigation steps.

Maria G: Great. Documenting timeline so far: 
- 1855009600 approx: anomalous increase in console 5xx begins
- 1855009205: controlplane deploy v3.18.4 started (canary)
- 1855009700: canary done, rolling ongoing -> mix of old/new pods
- 1855009876: incident paged via Incident Bot
- 1855009999: featuregate toggle (safe mode) applied to us-west-2 canary orgs
- 1855010200: cache warmup executed on affected nodes
- 1855010400: observed drop in 5xx, customer confirmations of recovery

Alex M: For RCA notes, we should collect pod env dumps and config-store request traces from 09:00-09:15. I'll grab them and upload to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1855009876/ (link posted in #incidents-private).

Maria G: Hypothesis update: evidence supports partial config/flag mismatch due to overlapping rolling deploy + feature flag state change. Cache misses amplified error path. Moving Hypothesis 1 -> likely. Hypothesis 2 (schema change) less likely but still possible; need schema diffs. Hypothesis 3 (cache eviction) plausible but secondary.

Sanjay R: Action items:
- Collect controlplane pod env and logs (Alex) - DONE (uploaded)
- Run schema diff between v3.18.3 and v3.18.4 controlplane models (Kevin)
- Add per-pod health gating to prevent mixed-state rollout (Priya to own follow-up RFC)

Kevin T: Schema diff shows no breaking schema changes in route model, but there was a change in featureflag lookup that no longer defaulted missing keys to false. That explains KeyError. Confirmed in code: featuregate.get('silo-routing-v2')[assumes present].

Maria G: Root cause (prelim): rolling deploy + feature flag removal combined with aggressive cache miss path led to KeyError in controlplane, returning 500 to console UI. Remediation: revert getter to safe default, add guard, tighten rollout gating.

Priya S: For customer follow-up, please prepare a short blurb: what happened, how it impacted, what we fixed, next steps. I'll draft and send to support.

Maria G: Handoff plan: I'm primary until 1855013000. If this regresses or new errors pop, page me. Otherwise I'll create a post-incident RCA thread and assign owners for follow-ups (feature flag default, rollout gating, per-pod health gate).

Incident Bot: Incident update recorded: severity P2, mitigation applied, monitoring continuing.

Maria G: Thanks everyone. Closing live mitigation. Follow-up owners: Priya (postmortem + RFC), Kevin (code fix PR), Alex (logs archive + timeline), Sanjay (playbook update).

Sanjay R: One more note - add a small test that simulates missing flag during canary to catch this earlier.

Maria G: Agreed. I'll add to the action items. Posting final notes to the incidents doc and starting the RCA draft.

Kevin T: PR #4923 created to add safe default for featuregate.get and unit tests.

Alex M: Logs + traces uploaded. I'll ping in private channel with link to S3 and retention details.

Maria G: OK closing thread for now. Will update when RCA doc is ready. :white_check_mark:
